plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/22916
Partner_Breach rule applied: Global-e Online Ltd. (Israeli cross-border e-commerce / merchant-of-record platform; NAICS 541990 as an e-commerce services provider, reviewer may prefer 518210) is the primary victim; Ledger SAS (French hardware-wallet maker, NAICS 334118; issue gives 334110) is the secondary victim. Global-e's notice refers to brands and retailers generally, but no other merchant is named, so only Ledger is listed.
Template Hacking-ext-unknown used; asset S - Unknown and vector Unknown (no entry point described) plus Partner. Data: names, contact info (and order data) -> Personal; no count disclosed. Motive Unknown.
Timeline: begin date not disclosed; coded 2026-01 from the Jan 5 disclosure; dbir_year 2027. Headcount Unknown (not looked up; Global-e is roughly 1,000 staff).

event_chain.summary: Access to Global-e systems, method not disclosed

summary: In early January 2026 e-commerce merchant-of-record platform Global-e notified customers of an incident involving unauthorized access to order data in its information systems. Hardware wallet maker Ledger confirmed that data of customers who bought on Ledger.com through Global-e, including names and contact information, was exposed; Ledger said its own platform, devices and customers' crypto assets were not affected.
